name: concept-explainer
description: An agent skill that explains a repo, a PR, a change, a proposal, a migration, an incident or a concept as one interactive page: diagrams first, broken into parts, every claim cited.

scripts.validate:examples: node bin/concept-explainer.mjs validate examples/taskflow.explainer.json --strict && node bin/concept-explainer.mjs validate examples/pr-cursor-paging.explainer.json --strict && node bin/concept-explainer.mjs validate examples/proposal-live-updates.explainer.json --strict && node bin/concept-explainer.mjs validate examples/concept-idempotency-keys.explainer.json --strict
scripts.build:examples: node bin/concept-explainer.mjs build examples/taskflow.explainer.json --no-library --style clean && node bin/concept-explainer.mjs build examples/pr-cursor-paging.explainer.json --no-library --style clean && node bin/concept-explainer.mjs build examples/proposal-live-updates.explainer.json --no-library --style clean && node bin/concept-explainer.mjs build examples/concept-idempotency-keys.explainer.json --no-library --style clean
scripts.check: npm test && npm run validate:examples && npm run build:examples && npm run build:gallery
